meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析测序数据,产出质控报告与信号图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做基因组测序研究,需要把比对数据转成可视化结果。
copy.tagline_en: Turn sequencing data into QC charts and genome-wide signal maps.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study genomes and need to visualize sequencing data for QC.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把 BAM 比对文件转成归一化的 bigWig 覆盖度文件,做相关性、PCA、指纹等质控,还能在 TSS 或峰区画热图和 profile 曲线,用于 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 数据。
howto.when: 当你说「BAM 转 bigWig」「检查 ChIP 质量」「在 TSS 画信号热图」等,或要分析 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 数据时,它会接管。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can convert BAM files to normalized bigWig coverage tracks, run QC such as correlation, PCA and fingerprint plots, and draw heatmaps or profile plots around TSS and peaks for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq and ATAC-seq data.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to convert BAM to bigWig, check ChIP quality, or plot signal heatmaps, or when analyzing ChIP-seq, RNA-seq or ATAC-seq data.

say_en.text: Convert this ChIP BAM to a normalized bigWig
say_en.note: Runs bamCoverage to make a coverage track

say_en.text: Run correlation and PCA on my two samples
say_en.note: Outputs a correlation heatmap and PCA plot

say_en.text: Draw a ChIP signal heatmap around TSS
say_en.note: Computes the matrix, then plots the heatmap
